location: Can Tho / Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
bio: Founder @MekongAquaBot. Autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) + acoustic biomass sensing for intensive shrimp aquaculture across the Mekong Delta.
discovered_via: SEG-01: SEA Embodied AI & Robotics Founders

recent_posts.text: Deployed 18 solar-powered ASVs across 45 shrimp ponds in Bac Lieu this quarter. By coupling hydrophone feeding-click detection with dissolved oxygen mapping, farms cut feed waste by 21% (~$1,400 saved per pond per harvest cycle).
